business_problem: iFood needed AI infrastructure that could personalize the ordering experience for tens of millions of monthly orders, improve fraud prevention, and standardize model implementation work for internal developers at marketplace scale.
solution_summary: iFood uses AWS generative AI and ML services to support two high-impact areas of its marketplace: customer experience personalization and internal developer productivity. Amazon Bedrock and Amazon SageMaker give the company standard building blocks for model implementation, experimentation, and deployment across recommendation, fraud-prevention, and delivery-experience workflows. When users open the iFood app and place orders, they are routed through a large portfolio of AI models that tailor recommendations and operational decisions at scale. The same AWS services also help the engineering organization standardize how new AI features are introduced so teams can move faster without rebuilding core infrastructure. This combination lets iFood apply AI throughout the full order journey, from discovery to delivery, while supporting the operational complexity of a national marketplace.

solution_components.name: Amazon Bedrock
solution_components.role: Helps standardize and accelerate generative-AI implementations across iFood's marketplace experiences.

solution_components.name: Amazon SageMaker
solution_components.role: Provides the central environment for iFood's data, analytics, and AI model work.

data_flow: User interactions and order journeys in the iFood app pass through AI workflows built on Amazon Bedrock and Amazon SageMaker, which power personalization, fraud prevention, and developer-facing model implementations across the marketplace.
business_outcome: iFood uses AI at the scale of more than 80 million monthly orders and more than 330,000 partner establishments, routing each purchase through more than 100 AI models to personalize recommendations, improve fraud prevention, and speed internal AI development.
